title: Gaza Sunbirds w/ Karim Ali
author: Josh Frank
content:
On this episode of CounterPunch Radio, Tori Tsui talks with Karim Ali, co-
founder of the Gaza Sunbirds. Karim Ali is a Palestinian award-winning
community organiser and co-founder of the Gaza Sunbirds - a para-cycling team
of Palestinian amputee athletes.

The post [Gaza Sunbirds w/ Karim
Ali](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/06/26/gaza-sunbirds-w-karim-ali/)
appeared first on [CounterPunch.org](https://www.counterpunch.org).
